answer.report_md:
### 画出来要什么
两个水平堆积条形图，无外框和背景线。标题很长，起概括说明作用。第一张图实际上有两个并排的独立面板，各自带有不同标题，共用一部分但不完全相同的Y轴类别标签。Y轴类别文字右对齐。图形没有X轴，值直接印在条形内部或者旁边（第一张图），以及印在第二张图的各段条形上。

### 定位一个值难在哪
定位 `82` 需要关联它所在的行类别 `India` 和它的颜色对应的图例 `Beneficial`。第二图的标题没有编号，只有加粗的长说明文字和绿色的副标题。由于图表本身没有明确的值轴和刻度，如果生成出来的 markdown 表格丢失了图例或分类标签的关联关系，将很难判断这个值属于哪一项。第一图分为左右两部分，各自拥有独立的类别集和不同的长标题。

### 不确定的
图一顶部的加粗文本是否应算作整个图表的标题，还是仅仅为导语文本。图一实际上更像是左右两张独立的条形图并排摆放，由于它们共用的类别并没有在中间而是在各自的左侧，这到底是算单面板还是多面板。第二图的标题是否包含前面加粗的整段长句。

heading.title: Consumers surveyed in both India and the United Kingdom are more concerned with the idea of an autonomous vehicle fleet when compared to surveyed consumers in Germany, Japan, or China.

key_parts.example: Percentage of consumers concerned about fully autonomous robotaxi services operating where they live

key: Percentage of consumers concerned about commercial vehicles operating in a fully autonomous mode on the highway
worked_example.why_hard: Panel title is long text forming part of a sentence with bolded keywords

heading.title: More than three quarters of surveyed consumers in India and China believe the addition of artificial intelligence in vehicle systems is beneficial. On the other hand, a quarter of surveyed consumers in Germany, the United States, and the United Kingdom remain skeptical about the technology.
heading.subtitle: Addition of artificial intelligence in vehicle systems

components.evidence: percentage numbers are printed inside the bar segments in both figures
neither figure has a horizontal axis with numerical ticks
two panels side by side, left has 7 categories, right has 7 but in different order and one missing
the main titles for both figures are long descriptive paragraphs
the legend with 'Not benefical', 'Neutral', 'Beneficial' is placed below the bars
text like 'Note: Percentages may not add up...' at the bottom of the page and under first figure
panel titles contain inline bolding like 'fully autonomous robotaxi services'

new_components.name: inline_bolding_in_panel_titles
new_components.evidence: panel titles have selective bolding to emphasize concepts

answer.hardest_step_why: 图表的标题都是长句子，且没有明确的编号，在解析出来的markdown中，这种上下文可能不会被识别为表格的标题或上下文结构，导致表格外文不满足第四步的条件。

examples.quote: More than three quarters of surveyed consumers in India and China believe... skeptical about the technology.
examples.why: 图表标题是一长段描述性文字，并且没有Figure编号，需要生成器支持这种长文本叙述式标题。

examples.quote: Percentage of consumers concerned about fully autonomous robotaxi services operating where they live
examples.why: 图一由两个面板组成，面板标题是长句子，提取数据需要把面板标题作为关键维度，当前可能不支持。

examples.quote: 13% and 82% inside the blue and cyan bar segments
examples.why: 数值标签直接印在条形图分段内部，生成器需要控制标签是在条内还是条外放置。
